description: Waterschappen Waterketen DAMO is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Deze dataset is gebasseerd op (geharmoniseerde) data van alle waterschappen in Nederland conform DAMO Waterketen waarbij we zoveel mogelijk rekening hebben gehouden met het Gegevenswoordenboek Stedelijk Water (GWSW). Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are afvalwaterketen, afvalwatersysteem, beheer, gwsw, kunstwerken. It offers 4 resource(s) in ATOM, PNG, WFS_SRVC, WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
